name: @maestro/tracklens-hook
description: TrackLens Claude Code integration - visual review, annotation, and walkthrough system

scripts.build: bun build:tsc && bun build:ui && bun copy:html
scripts.build:ui: cd ../tracklens-editor && bun run build && cd ../../packages/tracklens-review-editor && bun run build && cd ../../tracklens-hook
scripts.copy:html: mkdir -p dist && cp ../../packages/tracklens-editor/dist/index.html dist/index.html && cp ../../packages/tracklens-review-editor/dist/index.html dist/review.html

author: Maestro
